message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, does the heading “Inner Monologue:” match whose perceptions the prose actually presents? Where does the narration claim something Ya na cannot yet know? Which sentence deserves closer attention, and what evidence would distinguish her perception from the narrator’s assurance? Why would thinking further be worth its time over trying a revision now, and what unresolved viewpoint decision could make an attempt premature? Can you briefly name your finding, uncertainty, and chosen next step in English, then carry it out?
